summary: Implemented JWT access tokens and rotating hashed refresh sessions, a gated local identity adapter and DingTalk identity mapping, initial-admin bootstrap, user/role/group/department administration, functional/data-scope/field-level authorization, contact redaction, and auditable/exportable API operations.
command: npm run db:generate --prefix backend; npm run db:validate --prefix backend; npm run typecheck --prefix backend; npm run lint --prefix backend; npm test --prefix backend; npm run build --prefix backend; node --check backend/prisma/seed.mjs

checks.name: schema_typecheck_build_and_lint
checks.details: Prisma Client generated successfully; Prisma schema valid; backend typecheck, oxlint, and Nest build exited successfully. Seed script passed node --check.

checks.name: functional_and_data_scope_allow_deny
criteria: 建立用户/角色/用户组及部门数据范围，服务端拒绝越权访问并覆盖允许/拒绝分支。
checks.details: AuthorizationService tests cover a granted permission, a missing permission rejection, an in-scope candidate allow, and an out-of-scope candidate deny. CandidatesService tests verify the scoped query and not-found behavior for an out-of-scope record.

checks.name: sensitive_field_allow_deny_and_redaction
criteria: 联系方式、背调和流水实施字段或附件独立授权，访问与操作日志可追溯且可导出。
checks.details: AuthorizationService tests cover a user-group read grant and a denied write. CandidatesService verifies phone/email redaction, and IntakeService verifies a missing contact write grant prevents candidate creation. Background material and bank statement grants are represented by the same field-grant model and authorization API.

checks.name: audit_and_export_implementation
criteria: 联系方式、背调和流水实施字段或附件独立授权，访问与操作日志可追溯且可导出。
checks.details: Global AuditInterceptor and AuditService are wired; audited routes record actor, action, resource, request ID, outcome, IP, user agent and a safe summary. Audit API implements permission-guarded filtered listing and CSV export with formula-injection escaping. These paths compiled; no live-database API smoke test was run.

limitations: The new migration was validated as source but was not applied to a database; no MySQL/Redis integration smoke test was run.
DingTalk OAuth authorization-code exchange remains assigned to ATS-017; ATS-004 provides the verified-identity mapping interface.
Background-material and bank-statement field grants are foundational authorization points; their attachment routes will enforce them when those resources are added.
